title: Low-cost robotic hand with mechanically coupled distal joints: CAD, firmware, MATLAB/Simulink models and bench-test data
description:
Repository accompanying the paper "Design and Bench Evaluation of a Low-Cost Robotic Hand with Mechanically Coupled Distal Joints" (L. Muñoz and M. Fernández-Fernández, Universidad de Talca), submitted to IEEE ICA-ACCA 2026.

It contains the Autodesk Inventor project and STL files of a five-finger, 3D-printed robotic hand; the STM32F767ZI firmware with encoder-based discrete LQR position control and FSR supervision; the MATLAB scripts and Simscape Multibody models used for kinematics, grasp simulation, motor identification and LQR design; and the experimental datasets and spreadsheets used for the motor characterization, FSR calibration, encoder comparison, bench grasp trials and budget reported in the paper.

The hand is a laboratory research prototype, not a clinically validated prosthetic device.
